title: Streeting urges closer trading ties with Europe to grow UK economy
summary: Health secretary’s comments push further than government’s position on EU in wide-ranging interview UK politics live – latest updates A deeper trading relationship with the EU would be the best way of growing the economy, which has an “uncomfortable” level of tax, Wes Streeting, the health secretary, has said. The cabinet minister said it would not be possible for any partnership with the EU to “return to freedom of movement”, but his comments appeared to leave the door open to the idea of a customs union. summary: Actor says comments from teachers and schoolmates about her size resulted in her barely eating at 19 years old Kate Winslet has described being shamed over her appearance as a young actor by schoolmates and teachers.
